t: This is Thames House, a large government office building on Millbank, on the north bank of the Thames beside Lambeth Bridge. It was designed by Sir Frank Baines, who was chief architect at the Office of Works from 1920 to 1927. It was first built as offices for Imperial Chemical Industries. Since December 1994 it has been the headquarters of the Security Service, the United Kingdom's internal security service. It was also the London headquarters of the Northern Ireland Office until March 2013.
